hypothesis: Replacing ReLU with GELU on the successful three-convolution BatchNorm SmallCNN may improve validation macro-F1.
test_policy: Training and original validation only; do not load test images or use test metrics.
comparison_note: Same three convolutions, BatchNorm, Adam 0.001, batch64, train-only weights, seed2112 and patience5. GELU30 isolates activation against the prior ReLU30 run. Long schedules extend only the epoch/time allowance; do not rerun GELU60 if GELU30 already early-stops under unchanged patience.
stopping_rule: At most 30 epochs, five non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 300 seconds checked between epochs. A UTC deadline independently limits the overall task; leave time for verification and documentation.
